summary: Added public schema_registry::write_registry with a mutable Write + ?Sized sink and borrowed crate-version string. It serializes the existing registry representation directly as compact JSON through serde_json::to_writer, preserving serde_json errors and I/O error kinds, without a newline or explicit flush. Added three integration tests covering exact output and escaped versions, dynamic and short-writing sinks with existing content, and partial output followed by a BrokenPipe error. Existing public APIs and tests were preserved. Build, all 18 tests, Clippy, and the final formatting check passed on Rust 1.93.1.
